verses.1: And these are the children of Aaron and Moses, on the day when Jehovah spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar, and Itamar.
verses.3: These are the names of the priests who serve as priests: those whose hands are used for performing rituals.
verses.4: And Nadab and his father Abi died before Jehovah, when they were burning incense before Jehovah on the shore of the sea. They had no children. Elazar and Itamar served before Aaron, their father.
verses.5: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.6: Bring the Levite’s staff forward, and stand him before Aaron, the priest. Then serve him.
verses.7: And they shall keep his instructions and all the laws before the altar, so that they may serve God according to His commands.
verses.8: And they shall keep all the utensils of the Tabernacle, and the utensils used by the children of Israel to serve in the Temple.
verses.9: And you gave the livestock to Aaron and his sons. They were given them by the children of Israel.
verses.10: And Aaron and his sons shall be punished, and they shall keep their priesthood. And the foreigner who approaches will die.
verses.11: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.12: And now, I have taken the lambs from among the children of Israel, from all the flocks of the Israelites. They became my lambs.
verses.13: For I have all the fields in the day of my death. I have sanctified all the fields in the land of Egypt for myself. From man to animal, I will have them all for myself. I will be Jehovah.
verses.14: And the LORD spoke to Moses by the way of the Red Sea, saying:
verses.15: All males from the age of six years old onward shall be brought back to their homes, to their families. Every male who has reached that age shall be brought back.
verses.16: And Moses punished them according to Jehovah’s command.
verses.17: And these were the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kahath, and Merari.
verses.18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon, for their families: Beni and Shimi.
verses.19: And the sons of Kehat were Amram, Yizhar, Hagar, and Uziel.
verses.20: And the children of Merari, for their families, were afflicted and suffered. These are the descendants of Levi, from their ancestors’ houses.
verses.21: The family of Gershon, from the family of Hlebni, and the family of Shemei – these are the families of Gershon.
verses.22: Their number is equal to the total number of all men born in the first month of the year. Their number also equals seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.23: From the descendants of Gershun, they will dwell there forever.
verses.24: And the chief priest of Ab’s house, Eliezer son of Lael, shall be my successor.
verses.25: And the children of Gerushalayim shall be protected in the tent of meeting. The tent itself will be covered, and the entrance to the tent will be sealed.
verses.26: And the nails for the door, and the hinges on the door, which are located around the house and around the altar. And all its other parts, for his service.
verses.27: And the families of the Amramites, the Yizharites, the Heveronites, and the Azizaelites – these are all the families of the Khatites.
verses.28: In the year of every birth, and above that, there are thousands and six eyes that guard the sacred place.
verses.29: The descendants of Kehat will dwell on the road to the temple.
verses.30: And the chief of the house of Av was Elizaphan, son of Uzziel.
verses.31: And from their worshiping the altar, the sanctuary, the lamps, the sacred vessels, and all that is used for worship; and also from their serving the priests, and from all their other rituals.
verses.32: And the chief priests of the Levites, Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, was in charge of keeping the sacred vessels.
verses.33: The families of the sick and those who are ill are all members of this group. They are indeed members of the “Merrari” family.
verses.34: And their numbers were calculated based on the total number of all males born in each month, plus six thousand and two hundred.
verses.35: And the chief of the house of Ab was Merari, son of Abihail. They would stay by the entrance of the temple.
verses.36: And the duty of guarding the trees of the garden, as well as its branches, posts, doors, and everything else related to it.
verses.37: And the pillars of the courtyard were around it, along with their capitals and columns.
verses.38: And the altars that were placed in front of the temple were arranged in a line, facing east. They belonged to Moses, Aaron, and their sons. These altars were used to keep sacred offerings for the sake of Israel’s descendants. The stranger who came from abroad also offered sacrifices there.
verses.39: All the commands of the Lord, which Moses and Aaron received from the Lord regarding their families, concerning every male born in the year, including those who were two years old and above.
verses.40: And the LORD said to Moses, “Count all the male descendants of Israel from the age of six years old onward. Then list their names.”
verses.41: And you shall take the livestock for me. I, the LORD, will make it happen under every tree among the children of Israel. And the death of the livestock will also happen under every tree among the children of Israel.
verses.42: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him regarding all the livestock of the Israelites.
verses.43: And every animal that was born, according to the number of their names, from the beginning of the month, was counted as follows: two hundred and seventy-five.
verses.44: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.45: Take the livestock under every tree in Israel. And take the dead animals under their carcasses. Then I will be their God.
verses.46: And also those three, seventy, and the hundreds who were chosen over the Levites from among the children of Israel.
verses.47: And you shall take five and five shekels for each grain of grain that is used in the offering. For the sacred grain, you shall take seventy shekels.
verses.48: And the money was given to Aaron and his sons as a reward for their efforts.
verses.49: And Moses took the money from those who had paid for the sacrifices.
verses.50: From the spoils taken from the children of Israel, five hundred and sixty-three thousand shekels were taken.
verses.51: And Moses gave the money of the redemption to Aaron and his sons, according to what Jehovah had commanded Moses.
